title: HiddenBackend
description: Hides your backend from pings on the server list
body:
## Description:
HiddenBackend is a **Paper Only** plugin, it won't work correctly on Spigot.

## Tested Versions:
- 1.20.6
- 1.20.4
- 1.13.2

## Usage
Put the plugin in the ```plugins``` folder.
Start the server.
Done!
## What does it actually do?

This:
![Very Cool Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/366bc84fcf38922a65fc50024ca96a82145d43df.png)


### Commands:
- /hiddenbackend | Toggles the plugin
- /hiddenbackend debug | Debug mode for more information when the server gets pinged
### Aliases:
- /hb
